create_warp_texture: create a Warp texture from MuJoCo model texture data for GPU rendering
get_rgb_render_data: get RGB pixel data from the render context buffers for a given camera index
get_depth_render_data: get scaled and clamped depth data from the render context buffers for a given camera index
get_segmentation_data: get per-pixel object_id and object_type segmentation data from the render context buffers
compute_ray_direction: compute ray direction for a pixel with per-world camera parameters in a Warp kernel
